name: Weekly social content planner
why: Plans next week's posts from last week's numbers, a good partner to the weekly Pin batch when Pinterest is one of several channels.

name: Monthly content repurposer
why: Picks your best pieces of the month and turns them into new formats, a source of fresh pages and angles for Pins.

name: Product photo shoot planner
why: Plans a matching set of product photos, so you have enough distinct images to make several fresh Pins per product.

name: Store blog plan builder
why: Plans blog posts that feed your collections, filling the content gaps the seasonal calendar finds.

name: Shopper question and fan-out mapper
why: Collects the questions shoppers ask about your products, a strong source of seed phrases for boards and Pin titles.

name: Job-based avatar builder
why: Turns buyer stories into the reasons people buy, which helps you write Pins about what people are planning, not product specs.

name: Brand stylescape planner
why: Sets photo rules, type and colour for your brand, so every Pin brief points the designer at one consistent look.

name: Sale season pacing sheet builder
why: Builds scale, hold and cut rules for the sale season, useful when Pinterest ads join the holiday plan.

name: Influencer gifting planner
why: Plans a gifting round with a disclosure line, for creator Pins that need #ad or a paid partnership label.

name: Platform ROAS reality check
why: Compares what Pinterest Ads reports with your shop totals before you move budget.
